_comment: Virtual EdgeTX Classic-mode USB joystick (docs/SIM-EVDEV.md). Every field is a PARAMETER of the emulator; see _provenance for what is known. Nothing here was measured on a real TX12 MKII (HW).
name: OpenTX TX12MK2 Joystick

_provenance.vendor/product: SRC EdgeTX/edgetx main radio/src/targets/common/arm/stm32/usbd_desc.c:68,89-90 (0x1209 pid.codes, PID 0x4F54 'OpenTX assigned PID')
_provenance.name: UNVERIFIED: usbhid names the evdev node '<iManufacturer> <iProduct>'; manufacturer string is 'OpenTX' (SRC usbd_desc.c:71), product is USB_NAME + ' Joystick' (SRC usbd_desc.c:91) but the USB_NAME value of the TX12 MKII build was not found
_provenance.version: UNVERIFIED: bcdDevice comment says 2.00 (usbd_desc.c:209), not checked for the TX12 MKII build
_provenance.axes names: SRC usb_joystick.cpp HID_JOYSTICK_ClassicReportDesc: usages X Y Z Rx Ry Rz Slider Dial = CH1..CH8; INF Linux hid-input: ABS_X ABS_Y ABS_Z ABS_RX ABS_RY ABS_RZ ABS_THROTTLE ABS_RUDDER
_provenance.axes min/max: SRC usb_joystick.cpp:114-115 (descriptor LOGICAL 0..2047) and usbClassicStateUpdate: limit(0, channelOutputs+1024, 2047)
_provenance.axes value: SRC usbClassicStateUpdate: channelOutputs 0 -> 1024 (centre; also the initial state before any mixer output: INF)
_provenance.axes fuzz/flat: INF Linux drivers/hid/hid-input.c: Game Pad/Joystick application -> input_set_abs_params(.., fuzz=(max-min)>>8, flat=(max-min)>>4) = 7 and 127; verified against the 6.8 guest kernel by test_evdev.py (uhid back end)
_provenance.buttons: SRC 24 buttons; INF hid-input Game Pad rule: 1..16 -> BTN_GAMEPAD+n (0x130..0x13f), 17..24 -> BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY (0x2c0..0x2c7); verified by the uhid back end
_provenance.report_hz: SRC usbd_hid_joystick.c:224 bInterval 1 ms (FS) and mixer_scheduler: 1 kHz with RF off, module period with RF on (docs/CONTOUR-GS.md 3.5); real rate HW/UNMEASURED
